{{Youmay|''Starhook'', a Galactic Alliance corvette|''[[Starhook Ten]]'', a smuggling ship}}
'''''Starhook''''' was a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] corvette commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Voyce Evlen]].<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>  In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> the ''Starhook'' was sent by corrupt Alliance [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]] to meet with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] vessel ''[[Concussor]]'', which was secretly commandeered by [[Bhindi Drayson]]'s unit of [[Wraith Squadron]]. Evlen spoke with the fictitious Captain '''Avven Hocroft''', actually [[Wraith Two (callsign)|Wraith Two]] [[Turman Durra]] in disguise, who had previously transmitted a message asking Thaal whether he desired power. Seeing through Wraith Squadron's ruse, Evelen ordered her forces to open fire.<ref name="MK" />
